title: Admin Completion - Full Scope (A-01, A-06, A-07, A-08, A-10)

A-01.coverage: parseJwtExp helper (6), middleware redirect logic (6) - expired, missing, valid, malformed tokens

A-06.description: User Management (full scope - role promotion + suspended_reason)

endpoints.PUT /api/v1/admin/users/:id/role: SUPER_ADMIN only - cannot demote self, audit-logged with previous_role and new_role

A-06.ui: apps/admin/app/(admin)/users/page.tsx - phone search, role dropdown for SUPER_ADMIN, suspend/reactivate with suspended_reason display

A-07.description: Support Ticket Oversight with assignee management

endpoints.PUT /api/v1/admin/support-tickets/:id: adminWrite - update status and/or assignee, audit-logged

A-07.ui: apps/admin/app/(admin)/support-tickets/page.tsx - assignee dropdown (OPS_AGENT/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN), Start/Resolve/Close actions, View/Hide expansion, filter by status/priority

A-08.description: Live Orders with auto-refresh, detail view, and status override

endpoints.GET /api/v1/admin/orders: adminReadOnly - live orders filtered by status
endpoints.POST /api/v1/admin/orders/:id/override-s: SUPER_ADMIN only - force transition with optional reason, audit-logged

A-08.ui: apps/admin/app/(admin)/orders/page.tsx - 30s auto-refresh, Detail button per row with expandable user/restaurant/total info, override dropdown with reason input

A-10.description: Dashboard with sparkline trends and auto-refresh
A-10.ui: apps/admin/app/(admin)/dashboard/page.tsx - 60s auto-refresh, SVG sparkline charts for KPIs (weekly trend), CAC/LTV ratio, vendor churn, webhook failures with color-coded thresholds

code_quality.consolidation: User and Support Ticket fetch functions moved from inline page code into shared lib/api.ts with proper types (UserDTO, SupportTicketDTO, UserListResponse, TicketListResponse)
